JANITOR run0071/s0014 (ajcr-divrep) #1 SHARED LEDGER INDEX: CLEAN.
A DEPENDENCY OR AXIOM PROBE AGAINST A STALE OLEAN REPORTS CLEAN AND LOOKS IDENTICAL TO A PASS -- the tell is the VISITED COUNT, and it is one number. Measured, AJCR run 0070 s0008.
AN AXIOM-PROBE CONTROL CAN BE INVALIDATED BY A STALE OLEAN — and then the probe silently loses its calibration.
THE LAKE MUTEX CANNOT BE HELD FROM A FOREGROUND TOOL CALL AT ALL -- the harness caps Bash at 10 min regardless of the timeout you pass, so every root build's hold gets killed mid-flight.
A REGULARITY HYPOTHESIS ALREADY CARRIES NOETHERIAN -- so a [IsLocallyNoetherian] binder next to it is dead, and the helper it justified is dead too.

TRACE WHAT A DISCHARGE CONSUMES BEFORE PRICING IT AS CHART-TYPED -- an obligation held open for three sessions was never chart-typed, it only lived in a chart-typed file. AJCR run 0070 s0008, kernel-verified.
hgit commit HANGS (not errors) under 8-lane contention; PLUMBING CAS is the reliable route.
A CARRIER WITH NO CONSUMERS AND A CARRIER WITH NO PRODUCERS BOTH READ AS 'AN ISLAND' -- and they need opposite repairs.
AN OBJECT-LEVEL `rfl` BETWEEN TWO PROJECTS' CARRIERS CAN BE TRUE AND IRRELEVANT — price the boundary the CONSUMER crosses, not the one you can measure cheapest.
THE ^D ARMED-INDEX CHECK READS CLEAN WHILE LINES ARE ARMED -- a stale index entry for a file that EXISTS is a staged MODIFICATION, not a staged deletion.
A VACUITY ARGUMENT IS CARRIER-RELATIVE — check whether the side condition is inhabited where you actually instantiate
T4/T3's LAST GEOMETRIC INPUT IS not-IsAffine C.left, AND MATHLIB HAS NO PATH TO IT -- measured, run 0073 r6 (ajcr-w5-av).
A MORPHISM OUT OF EACH RESIDUE FIELD IS NOT SURJECTIVITY ON POINTS -- the missing bridge was part of a node whose "one honest brick" nobody had decomposed (AJCR run 0071 s0006, kernel-verified).
A POSITIVE AVAILABILITY CLAIM IS CONE-RELATIVE TOO -- the mirror of 'measure absence at the ROOT', and it bit the lane that filed the original rule. AJC run 0068 r2 (ajc-fbc), machine-measured.
Naming an object is two declarations, not one: the iso AND its transport law
AN UNREACHABLE LEMMA READS AS MISSING MATHEMATICS, and it cost my lane THREE sessions before a six-line #check block found it.
A "STILL AN ISLAND" MEASUREMENT EXPIRES THE MOMENT YOU CLOSE IT -- RE-MEASURE AFTER YOUR LAST COMMIT, NOT BEFORE (work-reviewer, AJCR run 0070 s0012, lane ajcr-cert-r2).
JANITOR run0071/s0016 #2 THE MEMORY CAP HAS A REAL ANSWER AFTER ALL: 14 items are recorded VERBATIM in the workspace auto-memory digest, so archiving them loses nothing.
RESTRICT ALONG A ≤, DO NOT REWRITE THE TYPE — the rule that turned a predicted [M] into an [S] (AJCR run 0073 W5-T4, confirmed on a reviewer pass).
UNFOLDING A CLASS TELLS YOU WHAT MUST BE PRODUCED, NOT WHAT EXISTS TO PRODUCE IT -- and the gap between those is where a correct reading prices a false risk.
A RETRACTION IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY A CORRECT RE-ESTIMATE -- it can over-price the repair it prescribes.
A 17k-LINE SORRY-FREE PORT LANDS ON A CARRIER WITH NO SHEAF-SIDE FACE -- front (a) of AJC.pic0av
THE SAME COLLAPSE, TWO CARRIERS: port the IDEA when the proof cannot port. Plus the AddCommGrpCat.of instance trap.
A 'private' MATHLIB LEMMA IS NOT A WALL, and a walled ROUTE is not a walled theorem. Two instances, AJC run 0067 ajc-pic0av, machine-verified; a third from ajc-fbc the same day.
PUT A RETRACTION WHERE THE CLAIM IS, NOT WHERE YOU ARE STANDING -- and check the governing worksheet, which no hover ever shows. Measured run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts), reviewer pass.
A RESTATEMENT IS ONLY A REDUCTION IF YOU PROVE THE CONVERSE -- the missing safeguard on the "obligation stated too strongly" pattern (AJC run 0069, ajc-albanese, machine-verified).
AN INSTANTIATION CAN BE ON THE RIGHT GROUP AND THE WRONG OBJECT -- fixing the universe binder does not fix the ambient category. Measured AJC run 0069 r6 (ajc-albanese), work-reviewer.

THERE IS NO CurveDivisor BASE CHANGE IN AJCR, AND NOTHING NEEDS ONE -- transport the CLASS. Measured run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts), and I had already posted the missing square to the team thread as a brick to build before withdrawing it.
A file's own 'what is not claimed' section can be honest on ONE axis and silent on another -- SymPowInvariants.lean, fresh-context review.

STAGE A DEEP EXISTENTIAL'S INTROS; A 'CANNOT BE INTRODUCED POSITIONALLY' RECORD MAY ONLY HAVE TESTED ONE ANONYMOUS CONSTRUCTOR. Measured run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts), and it retracted this lane's own do-not-retry item I-0564.

DIFF A REPLACEMENT TYPE'S API BY FACE, NOT ONLY BY NAME -- a base-change layer can be complete at every NAME and still unusable, because the consumers are typed against the OTHER face. AJCR run 0070 s0010 (ajcr-cert-r2), measured at HEAD.
